official_measurement_examples.name: 10 percent objective
official_measurement_examples.fact: Mandatory BNG generally uses a biodiversity gain objective of at least 10 percent for in-scope development, measured with the statutory metric.

official_measurement_examples.name: 30 year duration
official_measurement_examples.fact: Significant on-site and registered off-site habitat gains used for BNG must be secured and maintained for at least 30 years under the applicable legal framework.

official_measurement_examples.name: Metric update timing
official_measurement_examples.fact: Defra updated statutory metric guidance on 14 July 2026; metric calculations remain evidence inputs and do not by themselves approve a development.

official_measurement_examples.name: Future 0.2 hectare change
official_measurement_examples.fact: Guidance states that from 6 August 2026 BNG will not apply to planning applications for developments of 0.2 hectares or below; on 26 July 2026 that date is still future and must not be treated as already operative.

official_measurement_examples.name: Future NSIP commencement
official_measurement_examples.fact: Guidance states BNG becomes mandatory for NSIPs from 2 November 2026; this future commencement must not be applied to earlier applications as if already in force.

official_measurement_examples.name: Post-permission plan gate
official_measurement_examples.fact: For TCPA development subject to the biodiversity gain condition, the Biodiversity Gain Plan is a post-permission pre-commencement requirement and is distinct from the grant of planning permission itself.

official_measurement_examples.name: Off-site registration gate
official_measurement_examples.fact: Off-site gains used by a development must be appropriately secured, registered and allocated; a nearby registered gain site is not automatically allocated to a parcel.

official_measurement_examples.name: Credits last-resort gate
official_measurement_examples.fact: Statutory biodiversity credits are described as a last-resort route where on-site and off-site delivery cannot meet the requirement; purchase does not remove other planning or ecological controls.

core_rules: BNG metric output is not planning permission
a biodiversity gain plan is distinct from the planning-permission decision
registered off-site gain geometry is not automatic allocation to a development
statutory biodiversity credits are a last-resort mechanism not general ecological clearance
the 10 percent objective must retain its statutory scope and exemptions
30-year habitat management obligations do not determine parcel ownership
the 6 August 2026 0.2 hectare rule must not be applied before its stated commencement
the 2 November 2026 NSIP commencement must not be applied before that date
irreplaceable-habitat treatment must not be collapsed into ordinary metric offsetting
metric version and publication date must be retained with calculations
competent-person requirements must not be inferred as site approval
other scheme contributions may only count according to current BNG counting rules
BNG compliance does not replace protected-species licensing or HRA
BNG units do not reserve utility or development capacity
no parcel BNG clearance or Future Growth score may be promoted while recovery is parked
